name: Shared Strength
body:
School transmutation; Level antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 5, inquisitor 4, lathspell 3, paladin 3, ranger 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, F (a chain with links forged of different metals worth at least 250 gp)

EFFECT

Range20 ft.
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round (see text)
Saving Throw none (see text); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You call forth to your allies to lend you power for a crushing blow. When you cast this spell allies within 20 feet of you, up to a number of creatures equal to your caster level, may choose to take a -2 penalty to Strength for one minute and grant you a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls on the next attack you make before the end of the round. After you make an attack that has been enhanced by this spell you become fatigued for one minute and cannot benefit from this spell while fatigued.
